categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu M&S Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in satellite navigation, satellite communication, and electronic countermeasure products. Their business includes research, development, manufacturing, sales, and technical services for military and civilian markets, serving defense, aviation, and marine fisheries sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies in high-performance anti-interference microstrip array antennas, multi-channel frequency conversion, high dynamic signal tracking, digital adaptive anti-jamming, and integrated navigation and communication systems. Production involves customized non-standard and standard off-the-shelf products, with in-house assembly, testing, and quality control, supplemented by outsourced components and processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large military groups and related units, with products mainly applied in special fields such as national defense, aviation, and marine industries. The company also targets civilian markets including maritime and civil aviation sectors, with growing efforts in overseas markets through international exhibitions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily domestic within China, with limited and exploratory overseas sales mainly through participation in international exhibitions. Major facilities and headquarters are located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, manufacturing, and assembly of satellite navigation and communication terminal equipment and electronic countermeasure products. It procures components and modules from suppliers and integrates them into final products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in satellite navigation and communication technologies, expanding electronic countermeasure capabilities, and pursuing innovation in integrated navigation-communication systems. The company emphasizes technology self-reliance, continuous investment in R&D, and development of new products aligned with national defense modernization and emerging civilian applications such as low-orbit satellite internet and 6G integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of satellite navigation receivers, satellite communication antennas and components, and electronic countermeasure equipment. Sales are recognized upon customer acceptance or delivery, with military products often customized and civilian products including standard offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in satellite navigation and communication terminal equipment, particularly in military applications where foreign competition is limited due to export restrictions. In satellite communication, it competes with foreign brands but is gaining ground with indigenous technology. The electronic countermeasure segment is emerging with few domestic private competitors, positioning the company as a key player.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 139.36 million, a 57.94% decrease year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 271.65 million, reflecting increased losses due to industry environment challenges and project delays. R&D investment accounted for 53.1% of revenue, indicating a strong focus on innovation despite financial pressures. Total assets were RMB 2.29 billion with a declining trend from the previous year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its deep technical expertise, comprehensive core technology ownership, and integrated product solutions in satellite navigation, communication, and electronic countermeasures. Its products feature high precision, strong anti-interference capabilities, and adaptability to complex electromagnetic environments, providing reliable performance for critical defense and specialized civilian applications. The company also highlights its stable customer relationships and ability to deliver customized solutions.
